propositions: Bedrock region provenance is mislabeled: a rebar.toml config-file pin is recorded as REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION instead of repo-config because LLMConfig.from_env collapses CLI/env/config resolution into a single string via _llm_str, discarding the value's origin
resolve_bedrock_region labels every non-empty configured region with the same REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION tag, unable to distinguish true sources (CLI, env var, config file, or AWS default)

Region source metadata must be derived once during the same resolution pass that produces the region value, carried on LLMConfig.bedrock_region_source, and threaded through runner and provenance_for to avoid record/runtime divergence and regression in precedence (CLI > env > file > default)

A region from CLI flag rebar -c llm.bedrock_region_name=… should be labeled region_source=cli; from REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION env var or AWS defaults should retain their existing labels; from config file should be labeled repo-config
Resolution precedence must remain unchanged: CLI > REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > repo-config, then AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION; every precedence+label combination is pinned in tests
The resolved region VALUE and provider build paths must be byte-identical for identical inputs with no changes to wiring — labeling is additive metadata only
